name: hazel_weir_velocity_procedural_graph
description: Optimized Procedural Graph featuring 28-32 plot workforce-synchronized land scaling frozen at Day 15, dynamic midday liquidation floors with terminal clearance at step 696, proactive town shop arbitrage with dynamic Carrot plots, Days 22-26 endgame Carrot backfill, and backpack-gated micro-dispatch with pre-harvest well refills.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, total plot count, contiguous layout metrics, worker backpack saturation, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks after hour 18 and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation with true livestock-scaled feed reserves (n_animals * 3) to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Fulfills active town shop contracts for 2.0x-3.5x premiums. Prioritizes immediate shed inventory fulfillment (Strawberries, Milk, Wool) and dynamically allocates 3-4 plots for fast Carrots (Days 5-25) at >=2.2x base price, strictly barring slow single-harvest crops.

nodes.name: Capital Velocity & Liquidation
nodes.description: Abolishes shed hoarding by executing continuous batch liquidations of unreserved surplus at dynamic price floors: >=0.84x base normally, midday (hours 10-16) down to >=0.78x base whenever shed fullness >=40% or surplus >=12, emergency dump at >=0.74x if shed >=65%, and advanced terminal shed clearance from step 696 at >=0.70x floor.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) only when glut risk is acute (risk >= 0.52, price >= 0.82x base) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash into synchronized workforce and land scaling (10-12 plots with 4 hands by Day 4; 18-20 plots with 7 hands by Day 8; 28-32 contiguous plots with 10-11 hands by Day 14-15; hard land freeze at Day 15), decoupling daytime reinvestment (1.0x payroll), hyper-fertilized Strawberry procurement through Day 22, and hyper-fertilized Carrot backfill across open plots on Days 22-26.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with strict micro-dispatch sequencing: pre-harvest well refill and in-situ harvest-and-water recurring crops, backpack-gated shed drop-off (>=75% full or >=6 items), soil preparation and pre-seed hyper-fertilization, cluster harvesting, cluster watering, shed drop-off, livestock feeding, planting (Strawberries primary, 3-4 shop Carrots, Days 22-26 Carrot backfill), and tilling.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases; schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of unreserved, non-shop surplus inventory starting at hour 20 to guarantee payroll before midnight.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3); never hoard phantom wheat when n_animals == 0; never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery; do not trigger emergency liquidation before hour 18 during normal daytime production.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 or (net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.25 + 50.0 and active_shop_demand > 0 and day <= 28)) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Allocate market slots to fulfill active town shop contracts at 2.0x-3.5x premiums through step 710. Prioritize immediate preemptive delivery from existing shed inventory (Strawberries, Milk, Wool, Carrots) before open market liquidation. Dynamically allocate 3-4 dedicated plots for fast Carrots throughout Days 5-25 whenever shop contracts offer >= 2.2x base price and cash >= 1.25x midnight payroll. Bar all slow single-harvest crops (Pumpkin, Tomato, Cauliflower, Potato) throughout the match. Seed procurement condition: day + crop_growth_days <= 28.
attributes.pitfalls: Never purchase or plant slow single-harvest crops (Pumpkin, Tomato, Potato, Cauliflower) at any point, as they cannibalize recurring high-yield Strawberry plots. Do not abandon fast Carrot shop fulfillment or shed delivery, as that forfeits lucrative 2.0x-3.5x premiums to opponents. Never buy shop seeds if net available cash is below 1.25x midnight payroll. Do not allocate more than 4 plots to shop Carrots, ensuring >= 85-90% of land compounds hyper-fertilized Strawberries.

attributes.guidance: Execute batch sales of unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings at dynamic price floors: maintain >= 0.84x base price during standard operations (shed fullness < 40%). Permit midday liquidations (hours 10:00-16:00) down to >= 0.78x base price across the entire match whenever shed capacity exceeds 40% (or surplus inventory >= 12 items) to continuously recycle working capital for fertilizer and seeds. Trigger emergency liquidation at >= 0.74x base price if shed fullness reaches >= 65% to prevent shed blockage. Conduct terminal shed clearance starting at step 696 (Day 29 hour 12) through step 716 at a defended >= 0.70x floor to smoothly liquidate all remaining inventory without engine order congestion.
attributes.pitfalls: Never lock surplus Strawberry harvests at a rigid 0.82x floor when shed capacity exceeds 40% during midday hours 10-16, as capital freezes disrupt continuous fertilization cycles. Never dump below 0.74x base before step 696 unless shed capacity reaches >= 85%. Never liquidate Wheat below dynamic feed reserve (n_animals * 3). Never liquidate exact inventory quotas committed to active town shop contracts. Do not delay terminal shed clearance past step 696.

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) only when oracle_glut_risk >= 0.52 and current_price >= 0.82 * base_price before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not front-run on hypersensitive or weak glut signals (risk < 0.52); never dump into collapsed sub-0.82 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts.

attributes.condition: ((hour < 18 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.0 + 50.0) or (hour >= 18 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.5 + 100.0)) and (hired_hands < 11 or (total_plots < 32 and day <= 15) or uncultivated_plots > 0 or has_fertilizer_deficit or (day >= 22 and day <= 26 and has_open_plots)) and day <= 26
attributes.guidance: Scale workforce dynamically alongside contiguous land across three synchronized waves: reach 10-12 plots with 4 hands by Day 4; expand to 18-20 plots with 7 hands by Day 8; and scale to 28-32 contiguous plots with 10-11 hands by Day 14-15 (~2.7 plots/hand) to fully utilize workforce capacity. Enforce a hard land expansion freeze at Day 15. Decouple daytime reinvestment between hours 04:00-17:00 by requiring only 1.0x payroll reserve + action cost. Bootstrap Days 1-4 with Carrots, transitioning acreage on Days 5-8 into hyper-fertilized Strawberries compounding across 4-6 flushes. Enforce a hard Strawberry seed procurement cutoff at Day 22. Activate hyper-fertilized Carrot backfill on all open, harvested, or cleared plots between Days 22 and 26 to monetize endgame acreage across 2-3 rapid 2-day cycles before terminal liquidation.
attributes.pitfalls: Never purchase plots after Day 15 as late land purchases yield negative ROI. Never expand land when cash is below daytime reserve (1.0x payroll + plot cost before hour 18, 1.5x after hour 18). Never purchase Strawberry seeds after Day 22. Do not leave open or cleared plots idle after Day 22; always procure and plant hyper-fertilized Carrots through Day 26. Do not plant slow single-harvest crops on expanding acreage.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch hands following strict micro-dispatch sequencing: 1) Pre-Harvest Refill & In-Situ Harvest-and-Water: ensure watering cans are filled at the well prior to entering recurring crop zones, and workers harvesting ripe Strawberry plots immediately water the plot in-situ before departing if dry; 2) Backpack-Gated Shed Drop-off: immediately route workers to drop off at shed if backpack reaches >= 75% capacity (or >= 6 items) during daylight hours to liberate inventory for town shops and midday liquidation; 3) Soil Preparation & Pre-Seed Hyper-Fertilization: apply fertilizer to tilled soil before seeding to ensure all planted crops receive hyper-fertilization boost; 4) Cluster Harvest adjacent ripe plots up to backpack threshold; 5) Cluster Watering of any dry cultivated plots to eliminate regrowth halts; 6) Routine Shed Drop-off (scheduled before hour 21; all carried goods deposited by step 716); 7) Livestock Feeding (Wheat preserved at n_animals * 3); 8) Planting: hyper-fertilized Strawberries primary (Days 1-22), dynamic Carrot shop plots (3-4 plots max, Days 5-25), and hyper-fertilized Carrot backfill on open plots (Days 22-26); 9) Till/Weed new plots.
attributes.pitfalls: Never allow Strawberry plots to remain unwatered post-harvest, as dry intervals freeze regrowth clocks; ensure workers enter Strawberry clusters with filled cans. Never allow hands to hold >= 75% backpack capacity in the field during daylight hours, starving the shed of arbitrage stock. Never plant seeds on unfertilized plots; always apply fertilizer prior to seed placement. Do not hoard Wheat below feed reserve (n_animals * 3). Never create dispatch deadlocks if an action cannot be performed immediately; gracefully fall through priority chain. Ensure no hand idles while harvestable crops or dry plots exist.
